item.title: Why PRs need an investigative journalist
item.description: In PR, investigation is often the difference between a great story and a reputational mess. From verifying bold claims to quietly pulling the plug on shaky pitches, due diligence is the unseen skill that protects clients before the questions start.

item.title: The AI industry’s snowballing image problem is a PR crisis in motion
item.description: The AI industry is facing a growing PR crisis, with poor communication and inflated valuations fuelling talk of a bubble. This blog explores how reputation management and disciplined messaging are more vital than ever.

item.title: Why reputation management starts long before the press release
item.description: Reputation management isn’t just about crisis response. It’s about understanding how a business is perceived today, defining where it needs to be tomorrow, and using strategic, creative PR to bridge the gap. From maintaining trust to building credibility in new sectors, effective reputation management starts with insight.

item.title: What journalists wish PR teams understood about story quality
item.description: Reputation with journalists starts with story quality. Strong angles, real people, honest messaging and targeted pitches will always outperform noise. When PR teams think like journalists, relationships, and coverage improve.

item.title: Why AI news bias matters for your business and how PR can help
item.description: AI tools increasingly shape which news stories the public sees, often favouring outlets with licensing deals while overlooking others. As people turn to AI for business news, earned media in trusted publications becomes essential to ensure your organisation’s story is visible, accurate and not overshadowed by competitors.
